# WanderEngland

> England tour discovery platform. 1,424 bookable tours from 69 local operators, across London, Liverpool, Oxford, Cambridge and towns throughout England.

WanderEngland helps travelers find and book experiences from local operators in England. We aggregate tours from London and the major university and port cities as well as smaller towns, making it easy to discover walking tours, history and heritage tours, museum visits, food tours, boat trips, and workshops. Booking goes direct to the operator.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://wanderengland.com/): Search and browse England tours
- [All Tours](https://wanderengland.com/tours.html): Complete tour directory with filters
- [London Guide](https://wanderengland.com/london.html): London tours, 139 listed
- [Liverpool Guide](https://wanderengland.com/liverpool.html): Liverpool tours, Beatles history and the Albert Dock
- [Oxford Guide](https://wanderengland.com/oxford.html): Oxford tours, colleges and the Bodleian
- [Cambridge Guide](https://wanderengland.com/cambridge.html): Cambridge tours, punting and college visits

## Activity Guides

- [Kayaking](https://wanderengland.com/kayak.html): Sea kayak, river and lake routes; Derwentwater in the Lake District, the Norfolk Broads, Lundy Island from Bideford
- [Snorkeling](https://wanderengland.com/snorkeling.html): Shore and reef sites; Lundy Island, Skomer Island in Pembrokeshire
- [Whale Watching](https://wanderengland.com/whale-watching.html): Species, season and operators; Lundy Island, the Farne Islands off Northumberland
- [Fishing](https://wanderengland.com/fishing.html): Charter ports, target species and the season
- [Waterfalls](https://wanderengland.com/waterfalls.html): Waterfall hikes and viewpoints, with distances and trail difficulty
- [Ziplines](https://wanderengland.com/zipline.html): Zipline parks reachable from England, with course and age details
- [Jet Skis](https://wanderengland.com/jet-ski.html): Rental hubs, open-water routes and local rules
- [Shark Diving](https://wanderengland.com/shark-diving.html): Where encounters happen, species, and how to book a charter

## Things to Do Guides

- [15 Best Things to Do in the Cotswolds](https://wanderengland.com/blog/things-to-do-the-cotswolds.html): Bourton, Bibury, Broadway Tower, Sudeley, Hidcote, Blenheim and the Cotswold Way, with quad biking, river boats and half-day tours from Bath.
- [16 Best Things to Do in Cornwall](https://wanderengland.com/blog/things-to-do-cornwall.html): Tintagel, St Michael's Mount, the Minack, Eden, St Ives, Land's End and the coast path, with surf lessons and wildlife cruises you can book.
- [14 Best Things to Do in Oxford](https://wanderengland.com/blog/things-to-do-oxford.html): Christ Church, the Bodleian, punting the Cherwell, the Ashmolean and Pitt Rivers, the covered market, Blenheim, and which pubs matter.
- [14 Best Things to Do in Cambridge](https://wanderengland.com/blog/things-to-do-cambridge.html): Punting the Backs, King's Chapel, the Wren Library, the Fitzwilliam, the Eagle, Grantchester and Ely, with bookable punts and college tours.
- [15 Best Things to Do in Liverpool](https://wanderengland.com/blog/things-to-do-liverpool.html): Beatles taxi tours, the Cavern, Royal Albert Dock, the two cathedrals, Anfield, Crosby beach and the Baltic Triangle.
- [16 Best Things to Do in Manchester](https://wanderengland.com/blog/things-to-do-manchester.html): Science and Industry Museum, John Rylands, Old Trafford and the Etihad, the Northern Quarter, Aviva Studios, Castlefield and the Peak District by train.

## Quick Facts

- 1,424 bookable tours from 69 local operators
- Coverage is nationwide, concentrated in London (139 tours), Liverpool (24), Nottingham (21), Oxford (20), Cambridge (12), York (12) and Bath (10)
- Tours include: walking tours, history tours, guided and private tours, city tours, workshops, sightseeing, museums, food tours, boat tours, ghost tours, photography tours, axe throwing, and surfing
- Booking links go directly to tour operators via FareHarbor
- Most tours are priced in GBP; the median listed GBP price is £64
